svg.title: 同层冲突边，接上两条父链得到奇环
svg.metadata: {"version":1,"title":"同层冲突边，接上两条父链得到奇环","steps":[{"caption":"BFS 中 4、5 同为偶数深度；它们之间的边产生冲突。","image":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","duration":2100,"facts":{"left":[4],"right":[5],"sameDepthConflict":[4,5]}},{"caption":"两端同时上提，各自保存向上的父链。","image":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","duration":2100,"facts":{"left":[4,2],"right":[5,3],"sameDepthConflict":[4,5]}},{"caption":"在 1 首次相遇；只给左链补一次公共祖先。","image":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","duration":2100,"facts":{"left":[4,2,1],"right":[5,3],"sameDepthConflict":[4,5]}},{"caption":"把右链反转，才能从公共祖先继续向下走。","image":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","duration":2100,"facts":{"left":[4,2,1],"right":[3,5],"sameDepthConflict":[4,5]}},{"caption":"得到 4→2→1→3→5，最后由原边 5→4 闭合，五点奇环。","image":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","duration":2100,"facts":{"left":[4,2,1,3,5],"right":[],"sameDepthConflict":[4,5]}}]}
